caption: The heel of a hand presses into a ball of bread dough on a floured counter and the dough flattens and spreads.

sa.check: A ball of bread dough sits on a floured counter.
The heel of a hand presses into it.
The press comes first, then the flatten and spread.

pc.expect: The dough deforms only where pressed, spreading outward, without cracking or springing back like rubber.
pc.fail: The dough cracks like clay; or it springs back to a ball when the hand lifts; or it holds the hand up without flattening.

pc.expect: The flattening progresses with the press and holds; it does not reverse.
pc.fail: The dough rises back into a ball; or it flattens before the hand touches; or it keeps spreading after the hand lifts.

pc.expect: The dough stays put on the counter.
pc.fail: It slides; or lifts; or rolls.

pc.expect: Flour marks the dough and the counter where it is pressed.
pc.fail: The dough passes over the flour leaving no mark; or flour appears where nothing touched; or flour rises in a cloud with no press.

pc.expect: One ball of dough keeps its number, and the hand does not pass through it.
pc.fail: The dough splits; or the hand passes through it; or a second ball appears.

pc.expect: The dough's colour and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The dough changes colour; or the counter changes; or the kitchen rearranges.
